purpose: Fill the missing pre-action service context on fixed existing development trajectories before fitting a service-response model.
recipe: Zero-learning exact logged-proposal replay of the two existing v113 matched-no_fresh full days (stable and local_speed_drop), original F, natural24000 horizon. Retain action-before current native service context and actual post-action service events in isolated server directories.
source_confirmation: Bind each exact no_fresh action path and existing nominal accounting before submission. No checkpoint download or actor/learner restoration is needed for logged-action replay.
selection: Retain complete observations on server for reproducibility. At the unchanged57 packet deadlines, select up to5 latest eligible root-action records using maturity and timestamps, not cost, person identity, or successful boarding. Available after observed service-window end plus30; incomplete targets stay masked. Entire retained logs are not a285-record training set.
coverage: Capture at policy entry before applying the issued action, not ticks at the same start clock. Generic current feeder/stage observation must not require a preselected diagnostic passenger. Record ordinary/no-connection cases too; keep unknown fields explicit.
stop_rule: Require original full-day nominal action/cost reproduction. If inputs or legal mature records are insufficient, report observed coverage without synthesizing states, extending deadlines or selecting a favorable alternate day.
data_use: Development data for a common initial service module; exposed v116-v118 roots stay regression cases. Define whole-trajectory training/validation separation before any fit; later fresh/no_fresh share all new observables and initial module.
future_model: Train only after the sample support and held-out prediction assessment are specified. Actual connection-label accuracy alone never admits a controller. Fix a supported candidate selection rule separately before a full-day cost test.
cost_gate: Complete four days and technical checks. fresh-minus-matched-no_fresh mean<0,stable<=0,shock<0; additionally fresh-minus-same-actor-frozen<=0 in each scenario and at least one<0. Report no_fresh-minus-frozen to distinguish baseline drift. Early and tail windows are descriptive, not new gates.
downloads: server-resident full logs; bounded summaries only
